description:
Software Applications Engineer – Handhelds WinCE
 
 Work closely with the mobile computing business solutions and support existing relationships.
 
 Advise and develop software applications for customers using Microsoft Windows CE.NET and Windows Mobile and the operations of the products in customer installations and on wireless networks. 
 Work on application software development teams to support development for mobile computing platform(s). 
 Assist  in mobile frameworks tools selection
 
 

 Experience with commercial Android or Microsoft Windows application development/support experience with C, Microsoft C++ , C# and or VB.NET.  
 Experience with developing applications for portable OS systems - such as Pocket PC or CE.NET Operating Systems. 
 Knowledge of implementing component based and OOD/object oriented design concepts. 
 Experience implementing Internet based technologies such as JAVA, ASP, SOAP and HTML/XML is desired. 
 Symbian OS, Microsoft Windows Mobile, Palm OS, Linux, J2ME, BREW
